description: Address parser — Parse a messy free-form postal address into clean components (recipient, street number/name/type, unit, PO box, city, state, postal code, country), normalize US state names to USPS codes, check ZIP format, list missing parts and return COMPLETE/PARTIAL/INVALID plus formatted lines. Add verify=true to check a US address against the US Census geocoder (match + lat/lon). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
